info.title: GuraAha API
info.description: Generated from the same Zod schemas used for request validation — not hand-written. Regenerates automatically as those schemas change.

201.description: Registered - returns an access/refresh token pair and the user

400.description: Duplicate phone/email, or USER role not configured

200.description: Logged in - returns a fresh access/refresh token pair
Refresh token rotated - role is re-read from the DB at this point

401.description: Invalid or expired refresh token, or account no longer active

post.description: Revokes the supplied refresh token in the database and immediately blacklists the active JWT access token.

200.description: Logged out successfully (access token revoked and refresh token retired)

400.description: Failed to process logout

post.description: Terminates all active sessions for the authenticated user by revoking all refresh tokens and invalidating the active access token.

401.description: Missing or invalid authentication token

post.description: Generates a 6-digit OTP code and dispatches it via Brevo / SMTP to the user email or phone.

400.description: Account already verified or recipient destination missing

401.description: Missing or invalid token

post.description: Verifies the submitted 6-digit code, activates the account, and updates verification timestamps.

200.description: Account verified successfully — returns updated user profile with is_verified=true

400.description: Invalid, expired, or already-used verification code

401.description: Missing or invalid token
